name: AdminGlider – Responsive Table Scroll
author: wpcustom.ca

sections.description:
AdminGlider – Responsive Table Scroll improves dashboard usability by adding horizontal scrolling to wide admin tables when the available screen width is limited.

The plugin uses WordPress’ standard admin asset-enqueue system and does not print JavaScript or CSS directly into admin pages.

Features

  • Adds horizontal scrolling to wide admin tables
  • Works with standard list tables and widefat tables
  • Improves usability on tablets and smaller screens
  • Uses standard WordPress enqueue APIs for JavaScript and CSS
  • Lightweight and contains no settings screen
sections.installation:
1. Upload the adminglider-responsive-table-scroll folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate “AdminGlider – Responsive Table Scroll” from the Plugins screen.
  3. Wide admin tables will automatically become horizontally scrollable when needed.

short_description: Adds responsive horizontal scrolling to wide admin tables for easier use on smaller screens.
